newsitem.title: USA: Allied Group names Andersen CEO, president.
newsitem.headline: Allied Group names Andersen CEO, president.

text.p: Allied Group Inc on Tuesday said that it promoted Douglas Anderson to president and chief executive officer from president of its property and casualty unit.
The name of his predecessor was not immediately available.

Allied Group also said its board approved the repurchase of an additional 250,000 shares of its common stock during the next 24 months. The company has 57,000 shares remaining under a buyback program authorized in July 1996.
Completion of the program is dependent on market conditions, and the program may be terminated at any time, the company said.
As of February 28, Allied Group had 20.4 million shares of common stock outstanding.
On February 11, 1997, Allied Group Inc began trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "GRP."
